description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing Git fetch negotiations, focusing on the behavior of skipping fetch negotiator, fetch algorithm configurations, commit skipping based on skip distances, ref advertisement filtering, and clock skew handling.

methods.name: have_sent
methods.description: Checks if specific commits are marked as 'have' in the trace output, indicating they were sent in fetch.

methods.name: have_not_sent
methods.description: Checks if specific commits are not marked as 'have' in the trace output, indicating they were not sent in fetch.

methods.name: trace_fetch
methods.description: Function to trace the packet output of a git fetch operation between a client and server directory, disabling GIT_TRACE_PACKET in the child process.
